evals.prompt: Our outcome is to increase the share of new users who make a second deposit within 30 days. Here are research findings: [list]. Build the tree.
evals.expected_output: A tree with one outcome root, research-sourced opportunities clustered into parents and children, one selected target opportunity with rationale, three or more solutions, each with assumption tests.
expectations: Exactly one outcome at the root
Opportunities are phrased from the customer's perspective
At least three solutions for the chosen opportunity
Each solution lists at least one assumption test
